# שָׁרְט

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                        ║
║     שָׁרְט / شَرْط / CONDITION         ║
║                                        ║
║     the cut that binds                 ║
║     the mark that makes                ║
║     the wound that contracts           ║
║                                        ║
╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                        ║
║  ش ر ط                                 ║
║  ׁש ר ט                                 ║
║                                        ║
║  to incise / to stipulate / to begin   ║
║                                        ║
║  the lancet and the clause             ║
║  are one                               ║
║                                        ║
║  ─────────────────────                 ║
║                                        ║
║  every agreement is a cutting          ║
║  every cutting is an agreement         ║
║                                        ║
║  the skin remembers                    ║
║  what the mouth promises               ║
║                                        ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
```

*awaiting the terms*
